'''Merge Senses''' was a [[Sense]]-based [[Force power/Legends|Force power]]. It allowed the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] to merge their senses with another creature such as an animal or something with a lower intelligence than that. The Force-user was able to perceive the world through the senses of the creature; they would see through its eyes, hear through its ears, smell through its olfactory senses, and physically feel whatever the creature touched. The Force-user did not control the creature, but through simple suggestions and requests, could influence the creature. If the Force-user tried to influence the creature to do something against its nature, or inherently dangerous, the creature would generally ignore it unless the Force-user strongly imposed their will on their target. During the merge, the Force-user's body was sometimes rendered immobile, with its senses shut down.<ref name="BG" /> Some users had the skill to keep going, even hunting down that which was seen through.<ref name="DP" /> Withdrawing from the merge had to be done carefully, but the link could be broken if the host creature was injured or died. The [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[T'laerean Larn]] learned the power from the [[Wise Man of Kooroo]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gelgelar/Legends|Gelgelar]], and successfully merged with a [[Reeho (bird)|reeho]].<ref name="BG" />

[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] used this power as well, merging his senses into a long-necked quadruped he was hunting during his training under [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Plagueis]].<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
